module Unison.Merge.Synhashed

-- | A small utility type that represents a syntactic-hashed thing.
--   
--   The synhash itself is a lazy field so that we can avoid computing it
--   in certain cases, just using laziness.
--   
--   The <a>Eq</a> and <a>Ord</a> instances only compares syntactic hashes.
data Synhashed a
Synhashed :: Hash -> !a -> Synhashed a
[hash] :: Synhashed a -> Hash
[value] :: Synhashed a -> !a
instance GHC.Classes.Eq (Unison.Merge.Synhashed.Synhashed a)
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Functor Unison.Merge.Synhashed.Synhashed
instance GHC.Internal.Generics.Generic (Unison.Merge.Synhashed.Synhashed a)
instance GHC.Classes.Ord (Unison.Merge.Synhashed.Synhashed a)
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show a => GHC.Internal.Show.Show (Unison.Merge.Synhashed.Synhashed a)


-- | Utilities for computing the "syntactic hash" of a decl or term, which
--   is a hash that is computed after substituting references to other
--   terms and decls with names from a pretty-print environment.
--   
--   Thus, syntactic hashes can be compared for equality to answer
--   questions like "would these definitions look the same when rendered
--   for a human (even if their underlying references are different)?".
--   
--   The merge algorithm currently uses syntactic hashes for determining
--   whether an update was performed by a human, or was the result of
--   auto-propagation. (Critically, this cannot handle renames very well).
--   For example, consider comparing two definitions on Alice's branch; one
--   old one from somewhere in its history, and one new:
--   
--   old namespace new namespace ---------------- --------------- foo =
--   #bar + 3 foo = #bar2 + 3
--   
--   Either Alice manually updated #bar to #bar2, or else a dependency of
--   #bar was updated, inducing an update to #bar2. Computing the syntactic
--   hash can help answer that question. Let's combine a pretty-print
--   environment for the old and new namespaces together, substitute
--   references with it, and look again at the terms:
--   
--   old namespace new namespace ---------------- ---------------- foo =
--   helper + 3 foo = helper + 3
--   
--   We see now that our pretty-print environment has mapped both #bar and
--   #bar2 to the name "helper", so each version of "foo" would have the
--   same syntactic hash. This indicates (to our merge algorithm) that this
--   was an auto-propagated update.
module Unison.Merge.Synhash
synhashLcaDefns :: HasCallStack => (term -> Term Symbol Ann) -> PrettyPrintEnv -> PartialDeclNameLookup -> DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference -> Defns (Map TermReferenceId term) (Map TypeReferenceId (Decl Symbol Ann)) -> DefnsF2 (Map Name) Synhashed Referent TypeReference

-- | Computes syntactic hashes of non-LCA definitions.
synhashDefns :: HasCallStack => (term -> Term Symbol Ann) -> PrettyPrintEnv -> Defns (Map TermReferenceId term) (Map TypeReferenceId (Decl Symbol Ann)) -> DeclNameLookup -> DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference -> DefnsF2 (Map Name) Synhashed Referent TypeReference
hashBuiltinTermTokens :: Text -> [Token]
hashDerivedTermTokens :: forall a v. Var v => PrettyPrintEnv -> Term v a -> [Token]

-- | An updated thing.
data GUpdated a b

[old] :: GUpdated a b -> a
[new] :: GUpdated a b -> b
bimap :: (a -> b) -> (c -> d) -> GUpdated a c -> GUpdated b d

module Unison.Merge.Rename

-- | A "rename" is a venn partition of two non-empty sets of names: both
--   set differences and the set intersection.
--   
--   Invariant: the sets are all disjoint Invariant: it is not the case
--   that adds and deletes are both empty
data Rename
Rename :: Set Name -> Set Name -> Set Name -> Rename
[adds] :: Rename -> Set Name
[deletes] :: Rename -> Set Name
[unchanged] :: Rename -> Set Name
makeRenames :: Updated (Defns (BiMultimap (Synhashed Referent) Name) (BiMultimap (Synhashed TypeReference) Name)) -> DefnsF [] Rename Rename

-- | A "simple" rename is one that moves one name to another, where neither
--   the before- nor after-name have any aliases.
data SimpleRenames
SimpleRenames :: !Map Name Name -> !Map Name Name -> SimpleRenames
[forwards] :: SimpleRenames -> !Map Name Name
[backwards] :: SimpleRenames -> !Map Name Name
makeSimpleRenames :: DefnsF [] Rename Rename -> Defns SimpleRenames SimpleRenames

module Unison.Merge.Narrow
narrowDefns :: HasCallStack => GThreeWay PartialDeclNameLookup DeclNameLookup -> ThreeWay (DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference) -> TwoWay (Updated (DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference))

-- | Like <a>narrowDefns</a>, but just between the LCA and a branch head,
--   and for when the LCA is known not to have any type declarations with
--   missing constructor names.
narrowDefnsTotal :: Updated DeclNameLookup -> Updated (DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference) -> Updated (DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference)

module Unison.Merge.DiffOp

-- | A diff operation is one of:
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li>An add (where nothing was)</li>
--   <li>A delete (of the thing that was)</li>
--   <li>An update (from old to new)</li>
--   </ul>
data DiffOp a
DiffOp'Add :: !a -> DiffOp a
DiffOp'Delete :: !a -> DiffOp a
DiffOp'Update :: !Updated a -> DiffOp a

-- | Like <a>DiffOp</a>, but updates are tagged as propagated (True) or not
--   (False).
--   
--   This could be cleaned up a bit, but eh, it works for now. Historical
--   context: the concept of a propagated upddate was not in the initial
--   version of merge (which was only concerned with the merge algorithm
--   and producing the correct output). However, it is now being
--   incorporated, because when e.g. viewing a diff, we do want to see
--   propagated, not drop them.
data DiffOp2 a
DiffOp2'Add :: !a -> DiffOp2 a
DiffOp2'Delete :: !a -> DiffOp2 a
DiffOp2'Update :: !Updated a -> !Bool -> DiffOp2 a
isAdd :: DiffOp a -> Bool
isDelete :: DiffOp a -> Bool
isUpdate :: DiffOp a -> Bool
map :: (a -> b) -> DiffOp a -> DiffOp b
traverse :: Applicative f => (a -> f b) -> DiffOp a -> f (DiffOp b)
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Functor Unison.Merge.DiffOp.DiffOp
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show a => GHC.Internal.Show.Show (Unison.Merge.DiffOp.DiffOp a)
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show a => GHC.Internal.Show.Show (Unison.Merge.DiffOp.DiffOp2 a)

module Unison.Merge.TwoDiffOps
data TwoDiffOps a
TwoDiffOps'Add :: !EitherWay a -> TwoDiffOps a
TwoDiffOps'Delete :: !EitherWay a -> TwoDiffOps a
TwoDiffOps'Update :: !EitherWay (Updated a) -> TwoDiffOps a
TwoDiffOps'AddAdd :: !TwoWay a -> TwoDiffOps a
TwoDiffOps'DeleteDelete :: !a -> TwoDiffOps a
TwoDiffOps'DeleteUpdate :: !Updated a -> TwoDiffOps a
TwoDiffOps'UpdateDelete :: !Updated a -> TwoDiffOps a
TwoDiffOps'UpdateUpdate :: !a -> !TwoWay a -> TwoDiffOps a

-- | Combine two aligned <tt>DiffOp</tt> into one <tt>TwoDiffOps</tt>.
make :: These (DiffOp a) (DiffOp a) -> TwoDiffOps a


-- | An API for merging together two collections of library dependencies.
module Unison.Merge.Libdeps
data LibdepDiffOp a
AddLibdep :: !a -> LibdepDiffOp a
AddBothLibdeps :: !a -> !a -> LibdepDiffOp a
DeleteLibdep :: LibdepDiffOp a

-- | Perform two two-way diffs on two collections of library dependencies.
--   This is only half of a three-way diff: use <a>mergeLibdepsDiffs</a> to
--   complete it.
diffLibdeps :: (Ord k, Eq v) => ThreeWay (Map k v) -> TwoWay (Map k (DiffOp v))

-- | Like <a>diffLibdeps</a>, but for one LCA-&gt;Head side of a diff.
diffLibdeps1 :: (Ord k, Eq v) => Updated (Map k v) -> Map k (DiffOp v)
mergeLibdepsDiffs :: (Ord k, Eq v) => TwoWay (Map k (DiffOp v)) -> Map k (LibdepDiffOp v)
applyLibdepsDiff :: Ord k => (Set k -> k -> (k, k)) -> ThreeWay (Map k v) -> Map k (LibdepDiffOp v) -> Map k v
getTwoFreshLibdepNames :: Set NameSegment -> NameSegment -> (NameSegment, NameSegment)

module Unison.Merge.FindConflictedAlias
findConflictedAlias :: (Ord name, forall ref. () => Eq (synhashed ref), Ord term, Ord typ) => Defns (BiMultimap term name) (BiMultimap typ name) -> DefnsF3 (Map name) DiffOp synhashed term typ -> Maybe (Defn (name, name) (name, name))

module Unison.Merge.Diff

-- | <tt>diffSynhashedDefns defns</tt>, given the output of
--   <tt>synhashDefns</tt>, computes the two two-way diffs (each consisting
--   of the "core" diffs, i.e. adds<i>delete</i>updates, alongside the
--   propagated updates, i.e. updates that have the same synhash but
--   different Unison hashes).
diffSynhashedDefns :: (Eq term, Eq typ) => TwoWay (Updated (DefnsF2 (Map Name) Synhashed term typ)) -> (TwoWay (DefnsF3 (Map Name) DiffOp Synhashed term typ), TwoWay (DefnsF (Map Name) (Updated term) (Updated typ)))

-- | Like <a>diffSynhashedDefns</a>, but for just one LCA-&gt;Head side.
diffSynhashedDefns1 :: (Eq term, Eq typ) => Updated (DefnsF2 (Map Name) Synhashed term typ) -> (DefnsF3 (Map Name) DiffOp Synhashed term typ, DefnsF (Map Name) (Updated term) (Updated typ))


-- | Combine two diffs together.
module Unison.Merge.CombineDiffs

-- | The combined result of two diffs on the same thing.
data CombinedDiffOp a
CombinedDiffOp'Add :: !EitherWayI a -> CombinedDiffOp a
CombinedDiffOp'Delete :: !EitherWayI a -> CombinedDiffOp a
CombinedDiffOp'Update :: !EitherWayI (Updated a) -> CombinedDiffOp a
CombinedDiffOp'Conflict :: !TwoWay a -> CombinedDiffOp a

-- | Combine LCA-&gt;Alice diff and LCA-&gt;Bob diff.
combineDiffs :: TwoWay (DefnsF3 (Map Name) DiffOp Synhashed Referent TypeReference) -> DefnsF2 (Map Name) CombinedDiffOp Referent TypeReference
instance GHC.Internal.Generics.Generic (Unison.Merge.CombineDiffs.CombinedDiffOp a)
instance Control.DeepSeq.NFData a => Control.DeepSeq.NFData (Unison.Merge.CombineDiffs.CombinedDiffOp a)
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show a => GHC.Internal.Show.Show (Unison.Merge.CombineDiffs.CombinedDiffOp a)

module Unison.Merge.PartitionCombinedDiffs

-- | Combine LCA-&gt;Alice diff and LCA-&gt;Bob diff, then partition into
--   conflicted and unconflicted things.

narrowConflictsToNonBuiltins :: TwoWay (DefnsF (Map Name) TermReference TypeReference) -> Either (Defn Name Name) (TwoWay (DefnsF (Map Name) TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId))
assumeUnconflicts :: DefnsF2 (Map Name) CombinedDiffOp Referent TypeReference -> DefnsF Unconflicts Referent TypeReference
instance GHC.Internal.Generics.Generic Unison.Merge.PartitionCombinedDiffs.S

[uniqueTypeGuids] :: Mergeblob libdep -> TwoWay (Map Name Text)
[unparsedFile] :: Mergeblob libdep -> Pretty ColorText
[unparsedSoloFiles] :: Mergeblob libdep -> ThreeWay (Pretty ColorText)
data MergeblobError
MergeblobError'ConflictedAlias :: EitherWay (Defn (Name, Name) (Name, Name)) -> MergeblobError
MergeblobError'ConflictedBuiltin :: Defn Name Name -> MergeblobError
makeMergeblob :: Monad m => (ThreeWay (DefnsF Set TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId) -> m (Defns (Map TermReferenceId (Term Symbol Ann, Type Symbol Ann)) (Map TypeReferenceId (Decl Symbol Ann)))) -> (DefnsF Set TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId -> DefnsF Set TermReference TypeReference -> m (DefnsF Set TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId)) -> m (Updated Names) -> (DefnsF Set TermReference TypeReference -> m (TypeLookup Symbol Ann)) -> Diffblob libdep -> TwoWay Text -> m (Either MergeblobError (Mergeblob libdep))

module Unison.Merge
data Diffblob libdep
Diffblob :: TwoWay (DefnsF (Map Name) TermReference TypeReference) -> GThreeWay PartialDeclNameLookup DeclNameLookup -> ThreeWay UnconflictedLocalDefnsView -> ThreeWay (DefnsF Set TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId) -> DefnsF2 (Map Name) CombinedDiffOp Referent TypeReference -> TwoWay (DefnsF3 (Map Name) DiffOp Synhashed Referent TypeReference) -> Defns (Map TermReferenceId (Term Symbol Ann, Type Symbol Ann)) (Map TypeReferenceId (Decl Symbol Ann)) -> Updated (Map NameSegment libdep) -> TwoWay (Map NameSegment (DiffOp libdep)) -> TwoWay (DefnsF (Map Name) (Updated Referent) (Updated TypeReference)) -> TwoWay (Defns SimpleRenames SimpleRenames) -> DefnsF Unconflicts Referent TypeReference -> Diffblob libdep
[conflicts] :: Diffblob libdep -> TwoWay (DefnsF (Map Name) TermReference TypeReference)
[declNameLookups] :: Diffblob libdep -> GThreeWay PartialDeclNameLookup DeclNameLookup
[defns] :: Diffblob libdep -> ThreeWay UnconflictedLocalDefnsView
[defnsIds] :: Diffblob libdep -> ThreeWay (DefnsF Set TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId)
[diff] :: Diffblob libdep -> DefnsF2 (Map Name) CombinedDiffOp Referent TypeReference
[diffsFromLCA] :: Diffblob libdep -> TwoWay (DefnsF3 (Map Name) DiffOp Synhashed Referent TypeReference)
[hydratedNarrowedDefns] :: Diffblob libdep -> Defns (Map TermReferenceId (Term Symbol Ann, Type Symbol Ann)) (Map TypeReferenceId (Decl Symbol Ann))
[libdeps] :: Diffblob libdep -> Updated (Map NameSegment libdep)
[libdepsDiffs] :: Diffblob libdep -> TwoWay (Map NameSegment (DiffOp libdep))
[propagatedUpdates] :: Diffblob libdep -> TwoWay (DefnsF (Map Name) (Updated Referent) (Updated TypeReference))
[simpleRenames] :: Diffblob libdep -> TwoWay (Defns SimpleRenames SimpleRenames)
[unconflicts] :: Diffblob libdep -> DefnsF Unconflicts Referent TypeReference
makeDiffblob :: (Eq libdep, Monad m) => DiffblobLog m -> (ThreeWay (DefnsF Set TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId) -> m (Defns (Map TermReferenceId (Term Symbol Ann, Type Symbol Ann)) (Map TypeReferenceId (Decl Symbol Ann)))) -> (ThreeWay (Set LabeledDependency) -> m (ThreeWay Names)) -> ThreeWay UnconflictedLocalDefnsView -> ThreeWay (Map NameSegment libdep) -> GThreeWay PartialDeclNameLookup DeclNameLookup -> m (Diffblob libdep)
data DiffblobLog (m :: Type -> Type)
DiffblobLog :: (ThreeWay (DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference) -> m ()) -> (TwoWay (Updated (DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference)) -> m ()) -> (TwoWay (GUpdated (DefnsF2 (Map Name) Synhashed Referent TypeReference) (DefnsF2 (Map Name) Synhashed Referent TypeReference)) -> m ()) -> (TwoWay (DefnsF3 (Map Name) DiffOp Synhashed Referent TypeReference) -> m ()) -> (DefnsF2 (Map Name) CombinedDiffOp Referent TypeReference -> m ()) -> DiffblobLog (m :: Type -> Type)
[logDefns] :: DiffblobLog (m :: Type -> Type) -> ThreeWay (DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference) -> m ()
[logNarrowedDefns] :: DiffblobLog (m :: Type -> Type) -> TwoWay (Updated (DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference)) -> m ()
[logSynhashedNarrowedDefns] :: DiffblobLog (m :: Type -> Type) -> TwoWay (GUpdated (DefnsF2 (Map Name) Synhashed Referent TypeReference) (DefnsF2 (Map Name) Synhashed Referent TypeReference)) -> m ()
[logDiffsFromLCA] :: DiffblobLog (m :: Type -> Type) -> TwoWay (DefnsF3 (Map Name) DiffOp Synhashed Referent TypeReference) -> m ()
[logDiff] :: DiffblobLog (m :: Type -> Type) -> DefnsF2 (Map Name) CombinedDiffOp Referent TypeReference -> m ()
emptyDiffblobLog :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Applicative m => DiffblobLog m
data Mergeblob libdep
Mergeblob :: TwoWay (DefnsF (Map Name) TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId) -> Maybe (TypecheckedUnisonFile Symbol Ann) -> DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference -> TwoWay (Map Name Text) -> Pretty ColorText -> ThreeWay (Pretty ColorText) -> Mergeblob libdep
[conflicts] :: Mergeblob libdep -> TwoWay (DefnsF (Map Name) TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId)
[typecheckedFile] :: Mergeblob libdep -> Maybe (TypecheckedUnisonFile Symbol Ann)
[unconflictedDefns] :: Mergeblob libdep -> DefnsF (Map Name) Referent TypeReference
[uniqueTypeGuids] :: Mergeblob libdep -> TwoWay (Map Name Text)
[unparsedFile] :: Mergeblob libdep -> Pretty ColorText
[unparsedSoloFiles] :: Mergeblob libdep -> ThreeWay (Pretty ColorText)
data MergeblobError
MergeblobError'ConflictedAlias :: EitherWay (Defn (Name, Name) (Name, Name)) -> MergeblobError
MergeblobError'ConflictedBuiltin :: Defn Name Name -> MergeblobError
makeMergeblob :: Monad m => (ThreeWay (DefnsF Set TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId) -> m (Defns (Map TermReferenceId (Term Symbol Ann, Type Symbol Ann)) (Map TypeReferenceId (Decl Symbol Ann)))) -> (DefnsF Set TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId -> DefnsF Set TermReference TypeReference -> m (DefnsF Set TermReferenceId TypeReferenceId)) -> m (Updated Names) -> (DefnsF Set TermReference TypeReference -> m (TypeLookup Symbol Ann)) -> Diffblob libdep -> TwoWay Text -> m (Either MergeblobError (Mergeblob libdep))

-- | The combined result of two diffs on the same thing.
data CombinedDiffOp a
CombinedDiffOp'Add :: !EitherWayI a -> CombinedDiffOp a
CombinedDiffOp'Delete :: !EitherWayI a -> CombinedDiffOp a
CombinedDiffOp'Update :: !EitherWayI (Updated a) -> CombinedDiffOp a
CombinedDiffOp'Conflict :: !TwoWay a -> CombinedDiffOp a

-- | A diff operation is one of:
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li>An add (where nothing was)</li>
--   <li>A delete (of the thing that was)</li>
--   <li>An update (from old to new)</li>
--   </ul>
data DiffOp a
DiffOp'Add :: !a -> DiffOp a
DiffOp'Delete :: !a -> DiffOp a
DiffOp'Update :: !Updated a -> DiffOp a

-- | Alice exclusive-or Bob?
data EitherWay a
Alice :: a -> EitherWay a
Bob :: a -> EitherWay a

-- | Alice inclusive-or Bob?
data EitherWayI a
OnlyAlice :: a -> EitherWayI a
OnlyBob :: a -> EitherWayI a
AliceAndBob :: a -> EitherWayI a
data GThreeWay a b
GThreeWay :: a -> b -> b -> GThreeWay a b
[lca] :: GThreeWay a b -> a
[alice] :: GThreeWay a b -> b
[bob] :: GThreeWay a b -> b

-- | An updated thing.
data GUpdated a b
Updated :: a -> b -> GUpdated a b
[old] :: GUpdated a b -> a
[new] :: GUpdated a b -> b
data LibdepDiffOp a
AddLibdep :: !a -> LibdepDiffOp a
AddBothLibdeps :: !a -> !a -> LibdepDiffOp a
DeleteLibdep :: LibdepDiffOp a

-- | A "rename" is a venn partition of two non-empty sets of names: both
--   set differences and the set intersection.
--   
--   Invariant: the sets are all disjoint Invariant: it is not the case
--   that adds and deletes are both empty
data Rename
Rename :: Set Name -> Set Name -> Set Name -> Rename
[adds] :: Rename -> Set Name
[deletes] :: Rename -> Set Name
[unchanged] :: Rename -> Set Name

-- | A "simple" rename is one that moves one name to another, where neither
--   the before- nor after-name have any aliases.
data SimpleRenames
SimpleRenames :: !Map Name Name -> !Map Name Name -> SimpleRenames
[forwards] :: SimpleRenames -> !Map Name Name
[backwards] :: SimpleRenames -> !Map Name Name

-- | A small utility type that represents a syntactic-hashed thing.
--   
--   The synhash itself is a lazy field so that we can avoid computing it
--   in certain cases, just using laziness.
--   
--   The <a>Eq</a> and <a>Ord</a> instances only compares syntactic hashes.
data Synhashed a
Synhashed :: Hash -> !a -> Synhashed a
[hash] :: Synhashed a -> Hash
[value] :: Synhashed a -> !a
data ThreeWay a
ThreeWay :: !a -> !a -> !a -> ThreeWay a
[lca] :: ThreeWay a -> !a
[alice] :: ThreeWay a -> !a
[bob] :: ThreeWay a -> !a
data TwoOrThreeWay a
TwoOrThreeWay :: Maybe a -> a -> a -> TwoOrThreeWay a
[lca] :: TwoOrThreeWay a -> Maybe a
[alice] :: TwoOrThreeWay a -> a
[bob] :: TwoOrThreeWay a -> a
data TwoWay a
TwoWay :: a -> a -> TwoWay a
[alice] :: TwoWay a -> a
[bob] :: TwoWay a -> a

-- | "Two-way inclusive".
data TwoWayI a
TwoWayI :: a -> a -> a -> TwoWayI a
[alice] :: TwoWayI a -> a
[bob] :: TwoWayI a -> a
[both] :: TwoWayI a -> a
data Unconflicts v
Unconflicts :: !TwoWayI (Map Name v) -> !TwoWayI (Map Name v) -> !TwoWayI (Map Name v) -> Unconflicts v
[adds] :: Unconflicts v -> !TwoWayI (Map Name v)
[deletes] :: Unconflicts v -> !TwoWayI (Map Name v)
[updates] :: Unconflicts v -> !TwoWayI (Map Name v)
type Updated a = GUpdated a a
